prosecutionDialogue.circumstance: UFP attempt to clear Blister ships to ensure safety of system commercial zones.

UFP Kestrels: Blister contact, this is Kestrel patrol. Vacate the commercial lane or be cut out of it.
Kestrel element has weapons lock. You are endangering Union commerce; break burn now.
Raid transponder identified. Turn away from merchant traffic and submit to inspection.
You are not local weather, Blister. You are a hazard, and we are clearing hazards today.
Kestrel flight prosecuting interdiction. Civilian corridor will be safe before we leave.
Condor: Condor command declares this commercial zone under active protection. Blister hulls will withdraw.
All batteries mark raider signatures. Disable engines first; leave no ship able to chase traffic.
Blister formation, you have ten seconds to clear the lane before the cruiser makes space for you.
Condor strike group assumes safety authority. Predatory traffic is now a target class.
Commercial zone shield protocol active. Blister ships remaining in-zone will be neutralized.

UFP Kestrels: Kestrel flight, fan out and box the raiders from the merchant lane. Keep them scared and moving.
All UFP friendlies, Blister tags are hostile in the commercial volume. Burn clean and prosecute.
Copy patrol net, raider drives are painted. We clear them fast, then shepherd traffic back in.
Condor: Condor to all Union assets: bracket the Blister hulls and leave the outbound gap toward empty space only.
Strike control confirms hostile raid profiles. Kestrels drive them; Condor batteries finish stragglers.
Friendly units, hold civilian-side fire discipline. Everything wearing Blister colors past the marker is yours.

prosecutionDialogue.circumstance: UFP asserts sovereignty in deuterium processing regions Arcworks operates.

UFP Kestrels: Kestrel patrol to Arcworks traffic: deuterium processing space is Union jurisdiction. Comply now.
You are operating armed industrial craft inside a sovereign control volume. Reduce burn and stand down.
Arcworks hull, this refinery lane is not a company border. Prepare for UFP inspection.
Kestrel flight is enforcing Union authority over processing infrastructure. Do not test intercept range.
Your claim does not outrank system law. Hold vector or lose propulsion.
Ibis drones: Ibis screen has your drive plume tagged. Arcworks craft will remain inside assigned vectors.
Drone swarm prosecuting compliance. Unauthorized maneuvering near deuterium plant will be corrected.
Ibis units confirm weapons safeties lifted. Submit transponder keys to UFP control.
You are surrounded by cheap machines with perfect patience. Stand down, Arcworks.
Sovereignty notice delivered. Continued resistance authorizes disabling fire from Ibis screen.
Condor: Condor command to Arcworks militia: Union sovereignty extends over every deuterium processor in this region.
Main battery is tracking your platforms. Do not convert an ownership dispute into wreckage.
Arcworks convoy, power down weapons and open your holds for inspection under UFP authority.
This cruiser is not here to negotiate mineral law. It is here to enforce it.
Condor strike control declares the processing zone secured. Noncompliant Arcworks craft are hostile.

UFP Kestrels: Kestrel wing, Arcworks signatures locked in the processor lanes. Push them off the infrastructure.
All UFP craft, treat armed company hulls as sovereignty violators. Disable drives before they hug the plant.
Copy that, Union net. Arcworks escorts are targets if they stay hot; let us make the boundary obvious.
Ibis drones: Ibis swarm to UFP control: target tables shared. Arcworks profiles are boxed and predictive tracks are green.
Friendly guns, drones are herding company craft outward. Shoot through our lane markers, not through us.
Ibis screen confirms missile primers nominal. Arcworks signatures locked; this compliance problem is small.
Condor: Condor to Union formation: all Arcworks armed hulls inside the processor cordon are valid targets.
Kestrels, force separation. Ibis drones, strip options. Condor will hold the big guns on the platforms.
Friendly net, this is sovereignty enforcement. Keep recordings clean and firing solutions cleaner.

prosecutionDialogue.circumstance: Arcworks defends Arcworks claim territory from UFP usurpers.

MK-IV: MK-IV militia to UFP intruder: this claim was cut and welded before your flag arrived.
Union patrol, you are trespassing on Arcworks working territory. Leave under your own thrust.
We built these lanes with our hulls and dead crews. You do not inherit them by announcement.
MK-IV engaging claim defense. UFP craft will withdraw from company ground.
Your sovereignty paperwork has no mass. Our guns do. Reverse vector.
ML-X: ML-X assault transport holding the line. UFP boarders will not touch Arcworks property.
Union craft, every meter ahead of you is claimed, staffed, and defended. Back out.
We carry workers, armor, and answers. Today the answer is no.
Arcworks claim defense is active. ML-X units will ram this dispute through your patrol line if required.
You came to usurper territory expecting compliance. You found a wall.
MM-IX: MM-IX platform anchored on claim. UFP presence is unauthorized and unwelcome.
This utility hull has repaired more of this region than the Union has mapped. We are not moving.
Arcworks control marks your vector as hostile encroachment. Correct it immediately.
MM-IX batteries are live. Come closer and learn what industrial-grade means.
Claim defense broadcast: UFP craft will exit the work zone or be pulled apart like bad rigging.

MK-IV: Arcworks militia, UFP signatures are inside claim boundary. Lock them and push until they remember the exit.
All company hulls, keep tight to the rigs. We know this ground; make the Union chase shadows and shrapnel.
Copy claim net, every blue-white transponder past the work markers is a usurper target.
ML-X: ML-X to Arcworks line: load breach teams, prime missiles, and let the patrol craft see we came prepared.
Company friendlies, anchor on us. If the UFP wants a wall, we brought armor enough to be one.
All Arcworks ships, hold claim geometry. UFP signatures locked; they look lighter from this range.
MM-IX: MM-IX platform to claim defense: Union targets are painted against refinery glare. Share solutions now.
Arcworks friendlies, draw them across the service gantries. Industrial cover is still cover.
Copy local defense. UFP craft are too neat for this work zone; let us dent the polish off.

prosecutionDialogue.circumstance: Arcworks refuses to pay Blister tribute demands.

MK-IV: MK-IV to Blister collector: Arcworks pays wages, invoices, and debts. We do not pay tribute.
Your governor can bill the vacuum. This claim stays closed to extortion.
Blister raider, you are confusing a working company with a frightened village. Correct yourself.
No dues, no cut, no governor share. Leave before we make an example for accounting.
Arcworks denial logged. MK-IV militia is ready to repossess your courage.
ML-X: ML-X convoy response: tribute demand rejected. Further pressure will be treated as attempted seizure.
Tell your local governor Arcworks recognizes contracts, not hungry titles.
You want payment? Salvage what you can carry after we finish firing.
This transport is armored for bad negotiations. Yours just became one.
Blister claimants will clear our route now, or be cleared from it in pieces.

MK-IV: Arcworks escorts, tribute collectors are live threats. No payment, no pause, no mercy for boarding clamps.
Company net, Blister ships are targets if they block the route. Light them before they start counting.
Copy all Arcworks hulls: protect the ledger by protecting the cargo. The raiders get nothing but debris.
ML-X: ML-X to convoy guard: Blister tribute demand is denied. Prime launchers and keep the haulers covered.
All company friendlies, let the collectors close if they want. Our armor likes short conversations.
Arcworks route net, Sledge and Dragoon tags are hostile. We pay in return fire today.

sledges: Sledge crew to UFP hull: drop your cargo clamps and keep the uniforms breathing.
Union ship, your patrol route crosses our table. Pay in stores or pay in plating.
Heavy hooks are armed. We are taking your supplies before your cruiser hears about it.
UFP target marked. Break formation and we only strip the lockers.
Sledge boarding burn active. Stand by for collection under local custom.
dragoons: Dragoon element on attack vector. UFP escort, turn slow and make this cheap.
We have your flank, Union bird. Spill decoys, cargo, and pride in that order.
Blister dragoons prosecuting raid. Disable the patrol craft; scare the rest.
Your badge does not patch holes. Kill burn and accept terms.
UFP contact, this is not a battle line. This is a robbery with engines.

sledges: Sledge crews, Union hulls are fat with stores. Hook the slow one and let the escort panic.
Blister pack, UFP signatures locked, clamps armed. This is too easy if nobody gets poetic.
All raiders, strip supplies first and trophies second. Dead patrols bring cruisers; empty patrols bring stories.
dragoons: Dragoon flight, UFP patrol is painted. Missiles primed; run their flank before they find their formation.
Raid net, keep the uniforms busy while the Sledges bite the cargo locks.
Copy pack lead, blue signatures are boxed. Let us make the Union buy this lane twice.

prosecutionDialogue.circumstance: Blister demands Arcworks pay tribute to local governors.

sledge: Sledge collector to Arcworks convoy: local governor wants his due. Open the transfer ledger.
You work this rock under our sky. Tribute keeps your crews unventilated.
Arcworks hull, stop pretending machinery is a flag. Pay the governor and pass.
We brought breaching clamps because polite invoices make you deaf.
Tribute window is open. Refusal makes your next shipment ours.
dragoons: Dragoon riders marking Arcworks traffic. Governor tax is due before you cross this lane.
Company ships pay like everyone else, or they drift like warnings.
We are not here for your contracts. We are here for the local share.
Arcworks escort, move aside and let the accountants with guns work.
Tribute refusal authorizes pursuit. Try us and explain the debris to your hub.
Matador: Matador command to Arcworks claimants: the governor recognizes your profits. Now recognize his tribute.
Main guns are awake. Pay the lane tithe or watch your refinery traffic stop.
Arcworks territory is useful. That is why it owes rent.
You may keep your badges, manifests, and speeches. The tribute still transfers.
Matador holds the route. No Arcworks ship passes until the governor is satisfied.

sledge: Sledge to governor pack: Arcworks convoy is marked. Cut the lead ship and the rest start calculating.
Collectors, clamps are green. Company escorts pay in fear if they will not pay in fuel.
All Blister friendlies, keep pressure on the Arcworks guards. Tribute sounds better over alarm bells.
dragoons: Dragoon riders, Arcworks tags are locked. Sweep wide and make their haulers feel uninsured.
Governor net, company ships are targets until the tribute clears. Let us decorate the lane.
Copy collector lead, missiles primed. Arcworks armor looks expensive; expensive things teach well.
Matador: Matador to Blister line: hold the route and let no Arcworks hull slip payment by speed or swagger.
All governor ships, target escorts first. Once the guards go quiet, the accountants become reasonable.
Tribute fleet, main battery has company signatures locked. Push them toward the tithe marker.

campaignDefenderResponses: Piss off and try someone easier.
I'd like to see them try.
They've bitten off more than they can chew.
Tell them to bring more ships.
They want a campaign? We will give them a graveyard.
They can have this route when we are done using it to break them.
We are still here. That is their first problem.
Let them come closer. We have answers loaded.
They picked the wrong target and the wrong day.
We are not moving. They are welcome to learn why.
Their threats are louder than their guns.
They should have counted our batteries before starting this.
We will be waiting at the marker with engines hot.
They can explain this mistake to their survivors.
If they want the lane, they can bleed for every kilometer.
They are overextended and about to notice.
This attack ends when they run out of nerve or hulls.
They came looking for weakness and found a hard lock.
We have seen worse threats from worse captains.
Let them commit. Retreat is harder after the first burn.
They are not taking our ground by headline.
We will make this expensive enough to remember.
They are welcome to test the perimeter.
They opened the door. Now they can eat the room.
Stand firm. They have already made the fatal mistake.
